models_evaluated: ATBM Master (FotoFinder) total body dermoscopy module

links.outcome: Barriers to consistent use of AI total body dermoscopy module, including training gaps
links.effect: Lack of guidance, time pressure, and insufficient training were barriers to consistent use; only 3 of 14 participants had actual experience using the TBD module.
links.quote: First, several organizational matters were revealed to be a barrier to consistent use of the ATBM Master's TBD module, namely lack of guidance, time pressure, and insufficient training.

screen.reason: Qualitative empirical study evaluating clinicians' and nurses' experiences, barriers, and organizational factors regarding the implementation and use of an AI-supported total body dermoscopy tool in a dermatology clinic.
